item.title: Refined Evaluation Methods of Decryption Failure Rate in Lattice-Based Public-Key Encryption with Message Encoding
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1350

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

格密码是后量子密码最具前景的候选方案之一，其正确性与安全性高度依赖解密失败率（Decryption Failure Rate, DFR）的精确评估。当前面向带消息编码的格基公钥加密（PKE）方案的DFR分析方法普遍存在三大缺陷：过度依赖独立高斯噪声假设、采用粗粒度近似（如忽略离散噪声分量）、且未能充分利用特殊编码格（如Barnes-Wall格、代数格）的几何结构，导致理论界显著松弛甚至失真。

方法创新

本文提出一套精细化DFR评估框架，覆盖两大主流译码范式：

  • 最大似然译码（MLD）方案：首次精确刻画Barnes-Wall（BW）格的极小向量分布，结合编码格的对称性与距离谱，导出基于结构感知的紧致并界（union bound）；
  • 有界距离译码（BDD）方案：摒弃传统纯高斯近似，构建非中心卡方分布模型，显式建模高斯噪声与离散量化噪声的混合效应；
  • 代数格扩展：针对多项式环上方案，系统分析乘积系数的方差与跨项相关性，提出加权卡方分布+鞍点逼近法，首次实现对强相关噪声的高精度概率建模。

实验验证与价值

在CNTR、\scloud和CNTR-Prime等典型方案上验证：DFR上界分别降低约15比特（CNTR）、1比特（\scloud），而CNTR-Prime的DFR上界反向提升至少84比特（即安全裕度大幅增强）。结果表明，本框架显著收紧理论界，为实际格密码系统的参数定制、NIST标准化认证及安全声明提供可验证、可复现、几何感知的理论基石。

AI Summary (English)

Lattice-based cryptography is a leading post-quantum candidate, where accurate Decryption Failure Rate (DFR) estimation is essential for correctness and security. Existing DFR analyses for message-encoded lattice PKE rely on oversimplified assumptions—especially ignoring discrete noise components and failing to exploit the geometric structure of encoding lattices—yielding loose or inaccurate bounds. This paper proposes a refined DFR evaluation framework covering Maximum Likelihood Decoding (MLD) and Bounded Distance Decoding (BDD) paradigms. For MLD schemes (e.g., using Barnes-Wall lattices), we derive tighter union bounds by precisely characterizing minimal vectors and leveraging lattice symmetry. For BDD schemes, we model mixed Gaussian + discrete noise via a noncentral chi-squared distribution, avoiding error-prone pure-Gaussian approximations. We further extend the framework to algebraic-lattice PKE by analyzing coefficient correlations in polynomial products and introducing a weighted chi-squared distribution with saddlepoint approximation. Evaluated on CNTR, \scloud, and CNTR-Prime, our method tightens the DFR upper bound by ≈15 bits (CNTR), 1 bit (\scloud), and improves security margin by ≥84 bits (CNTR-Prime). The results demonstrate substantially improved accuracy and reliability for parameter selection and security certification.

Abstract

Lattice-based cryptography is one of the most promising candidates for post-quantum cryptography. Decryption Failure Rate (DFR) is a critical metric for the correctness and security of lattice-based public-key encryption (PKE) schemes. At present, most DFR evaluation methods for lattice-based PKE with message encoding rely on oversimplified assumptions, rough approximations, and fail to fully exploit the geometric structure of special encoding lattices, resulting in loose or inaccurate bounds.

To address these limitations, this paper proposes a refined DFR evaluation framework for lattice-based PKE with message encoding, focusing on two mainstream decoding paradigms: Maximum Likelihood Decoding (MLD) and Bounded Distance Decoding (BDD). For MLD-based schemes, we precisely characterize the minimal vectors of Barnes-Wall (BW) lattices and derive tighter union bounds by leveraging the encoding lattice structure. For BDD-based schemes, we introduce a noncentral chi-squared distribution based method to model mixed noise composed of Gaussian and discrete components, avoiding the inaccuracy of conventional pure Gaussian approximations. Furthermore, we extend the framework to algebraic-lattice-based PKE by analyzing the variance and correlation of polynomial product coefficients, and propose a weighted chi-squared distribution with saddlepoint approximation to handle correlated coefficients.

We validate the proposed methods on representative lattice-based PKEs including CNTR, \scloud, and CNTR-Prime, resulting in the DFR upper bound approximate 15 bits decreasing for CNTR, 1 bit decreasing for \scloud, and at least 84 bits increasing for CNTR-Prime. The experimental results show that our refined analysis yields significantly tighter and more accurate DFR bounds compared with traditional approaches, providing a reliable theoretical basis for parameter selection and security certification of practical lattice-based cryptosystems.

item.title: Sharper and Closed-Form Attacks on $\mathsf{SIS}$ When Modulus Is Small
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1349

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

Ducas-Espitau-Postlethwaite（CRYPTO 2023）提出的“大范数攻击”（Large Norm attack）揭示了小模数 $q$ 下 $\mathsf{ISIS}$ 问题的脆弱性，成功应用于Falcon与Mitaka签名方案。然而，该攻击存在两大关键缺陷：一是成本模型过度简化——其BDGL筛法建模忽略向量长度的实际分布，且将本应联合建模的两个强相关概率事件错误视为独立，导致攻击复杂度被显著高估；二是适用范围受限——仅针对 $\ell_2$ 范数，尚未拓展至支撑Dilithium类方案的 $\mathsf{ISIS}^\infty$（即 $\ell_\infty$-bounded 噪声版本），而后者在NIST后量子标准中占据核心地位。

方法创新

本文系统性解决上述问题：

  • 精细化成本建模：将BDGL筛中主筛长（principal sieve length）的概率分布显式纳入成功概率计算，摒弃独立性假设，改用精确联合概率分析；其余框架（如 $\theta$ 卷积结构）保持复用，确保扩展轻量、可验证。
  • 首创闭式 $\ell_\infty$ 攻击：提出Z-shape攻击——一种解析可解、无需迭代的闭式算法，专为小至中等模数 $q$ 下的 $\mathsf{ISIS}^\infty$ 设计，突破传统格基约简依赖。

主要成果

  • Falcon-256攻击成本降低 ≈11倍（修正后更贴近真实开销）；
  • Mitaka-512签名伪造实现在 ≈4.5秒内完成，成功率显著提升；
  • Z-shape攻击在Dilithium三档参数（Dilithium2/3/5）上均实现 ≤1.6秒 的确定性成功，首次为 $\ell_\infty$ 场景提供高效、可解析的威胁评估工具。

AI Summary (English)

This work refines and extends the Large Norm attack on $\mathsf{ISIS}$ for small modulus $q$. First, we correct its cost model by incorporating the principal sieve length distribution of the BDGL sieve and replacing heuristic independence assumptions with exact joint probability analysis—reducing the estimated cost for Falcon-256 by ≈11× and forging Mitaka-512 signatures in ≈4.5 seconds with higher success probability. Second, we introduce the first closed-form $\ell_\infty$ attack—dubbed Z-shape attack—targeting $\mathsf{ISIS}^\infty$ underlying Dilithium-type schemes. It operates analytically (no lattice reduction) and succeeds in ≤1.6 seconds across all three NIST-standardized Dilithium parameter sets (Dilithium2/3/5) at small-to-moderate $q$. Our results expose sharper, more realistic security boundaries for lattice-based signatures relying on small-modulus assumptions.

Abstract

The Large Norm attacks of Ducas-Espitau-Postlethwaite (CRYPTO 2023) on the $\mathsf{ISIS}$ problem have shown that small values of $q$ can be used to recover short solutions. This was applied to Falcon and Mitaka. Two issues are left, however. First, the cost model of the attack oversimplifies the BDGL sieve; it does not account for how long vectors will be distributed and treats two dependent probabilistic events as if they were independent, which results in an overestimation of the attack cost. Secondly, the analysis only deals with the $\ell_2$ norm and has not yet been extended to $\mathsf{ISIS}^\infty$, which underlies Dilithium-type systems.

This work addresses both issues. First, we extend the cost model of the Large Norm attack by including the principal sieve length distribution into our estimation of success probabilities. In addition, we use a joint probability rather than an approximate factor where possible. Since all other parts of the original $\theta$ convolution framework are reused, the extension is relatively minor. We reduce the attack cost of Large Norm on Falcon-256 by a $\approx\!11\times$ cheaper model, and successfully forge a Mitaka-512 signature in $\approx\!4.5$ seconds at a higher success rate. We additionally introduce a closed-form $\ell_\infty$ variant as a Z-shape attack against Dilithium-type $\mathsf{ISIS}^{\infty}$ at small-to-moderate modulus, which succeeds in $\le\!1.6$ seconds across three presets.

item.title: On Canonical Liftings, Group Actions, and (Linkable) Ring Signatures
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1348

AI Summary (中文)

提出“典范提升”框架，构建高效安全的环签名与可链接环签名

本文首次提出典范提升（canonical lifting）这一抽象概念，用于统一刻画群作用下的规范化映射机制。该框架系统性地推广了现有群作用型签名方案中降低签名尺寸的技术（如LESS方案所用的典范形式），为设计轻量级、结构清晰的密码原语提供了新范式。

基于该框架，我们构造了一个高效环签名方案，并进一步扩展为可链接环签名方案。关键创新在于：彻底规避了Beullens-Katsumata-Pintore（ASIACRYPT’20）框架中依赖密钥重用实现链接性的不安全机制——该机制近期已被证实对线性码等价群作用（ASIACRYPT’24）和格同构群作用（CiC’25）存在致命攻击。我们的链接性通过典范提升的内在结构自然实现，无需密钥重用，从根本上保障安全性。

方案性能优异：签名长度仅为环规模的对数级（$O(\log n)$），显著优于多数现有方案。所有安全性证明均在抽象典范提升框架层面完成，只要具体实例满足框架的三个核心假设（可计算性、唯一性、兼容性），即可直接继承安全性，极大提升方案的模块化与可验证性。

我们以线性码等价群作用为具体实例，实现了两个实用方案：环签名方案 $\mathsf{CERES}$ 与可链接环签名方案 $\mathsf{CELERES}$。实验表明，二者签名尺寸均优于当前最优方案；同时，我们提供了AVX2指令集深度优化的C语言实现，在标准服务器上达成毫秒级签名/验证速度，充分验证其实际部署可行性。

AI Summary (English)

We introduce canonical lifting, a new abstraction for group actions that generalizes canonical-form techniques (e.g., in LESS) to compress signatures. Leveraging this framework, we construct a ring signature scheme and extend it to a linkable variant. Crucially, our linkability mechanism avoids the insecure key-reuse approach of Beullens–Katsumata–Pintore (ASIACRYPT’20), which was recently broken for linear code equivalence (ASIACRYPT’24) and lattice isomorphism (CiC’25). Our signatures achieve logarithmic size in the ring cardinality ($O(\log n)$). Security is proven abstractly at the canonical-lifting level—concrete instantiations inherit soundness if they satisfy three natural assumptions (computability, uniqueness, compatibility). Instantiated over linear code equivalence, we obtain $\mathsf{CERES}$ (ring signature) and $\mathsf{CELERES}$ (linkable ring signature), both with state-of-the-art signature sizes and an AVX2-optimized C implementation demonstrating practical efficiency.

Abstract

We introduce the notion of canonical lifting for group actions. This generalises existing techniques for reducing the size of group-action-based signatures, such as the canonical forms used in the LESS signature scheme. Building on this framework, we construct a ring signature scheme and extend it to a linkable variant.

Our approach avoids the key-reuse mechanism for linkability of the framework by Beullens, Katsumata, and Pintore (ASIACRYPT'20), which was shown to be insecure for group actions arising from linear code equivalence (ASIACRYPT'24) and lattice isomorphism (CiC'25). The resulting signatures have size logarithmic in the ring size. We provide security proofs at the level of the abstract canonical-lifting framework, which are then inherited by concrete instantiations satisfying the required assumptions. Finally, we instantiate our approach using the linear code equivalence group action, obtaining a ring signature scheme, $\mathsf{CERES}$, and a linkable ring signature scheme, $\mathsf{CELERES}$. Both schemes achieve signature sizes that compare favourably with the state of the art, and our AVX2-optimised C implementation supports their practical applicability.

item.title: Revisiting the Quantum Indifferentiability of Merkle-Damgård: Proof Limitations and Optimal Consistency
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1347

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

Merkle-Damgård（MD）域扩展器的量子不可区分性（quantum indifferentiability）是后量子密码学的基础性问题。近期，Gorjan 等人揭示了现有 MD 构造一致性证明中的关键缺陷，导致此前宣称的安全性保证失效，凸显该问题在理论严谨性上的紧迫挑战。

方法创新

本文提出一个模块化量子博弈框架，将 Zhandry 的压缩预言机（compressed oracle）技术形式化并泛化，专用于分析由随机函数构建的复合系统。该框架将量子 indifferentiability 证明解耦为两个核心子游戏：不可区分性游戏（indistinguishability game）与一致性游戏（consistency game），并为二者提供统一的结构化分析工具。

主要成果

  • 一致性方面：设计误差传播技术，精确追踪一致性游戏中因采样失败引发的相干性惩罚（coherence penalty）与“坏分支”演化；导出紧致界 $O(q_s^{3/2}/2^{n/2})$，与通用量子碰撞攻击的最优复杂度完全匹配，首次实现渐近最优一致性保证。
  • 不可区分性方面：发现根本性障碍——在顺序自适应查询下，模拟量子态必然泄露至“坏数据库”子空间，导致预言机偏差存在非零下界；该缺陷同样存在于 Zhandry 原始证明中，解释了为何完整量子 indifferentiability 证明长期未能完成。

本工作不仅修复了关键安全边界，更揭示了量子随机预言机模型中结构性限制，为后续构造（如 Sponge、HAIFA）的量子安全性分析提供了可迁移的方法论基础。

AI Summary (English)

This paper revisits the quantum indifferentiability of the Merkle-Damgård (MD) domain extender—a foundational problem in post-quantum cryptography—after recent flaws invalidated prior consistency proofs. We formalize and generalize Zhandry’s compressed oracle technique into a modular quantum game-playing framework for systems built from random functions. Within this framework, we develop an error-propagation method for the consistency game, yielding a tight bound of $O(q_s^{3/2}/2^{n/2})$, matching the optimal complexity of generic quantum collision attacks. Crucially, we identify a fundamental obstruction in the indistinguishability game: under sequential adaptive queries, the simulated quantum state inevitably leaks into the “bad database” subspace, inducing a non-negligible lower bound on oracle deviation—a gap also present in Zhandry’s original proof. This explains why full quantum indifferentiability remains unproven for MD and underscores the need for novel techniques beyond current oracle-based paradigms.

Abstract

The quantum indifferentiability of the Merkle-Damgård (MD) domain extender is a foundational problem in post-quantum cryptography.
Recently, Gorjan et al. identified critical flaws in existing consistency proofs for this construction, invalidating prior security guarantees.

Quantum indifferentiability proofs typically reduce to two oracle-indistinguishability games: the indistinguishability game and the consistency game.
To analyze the systems arising in these games, we formalize and generalize Zhandry's compressed oracle proof technique into a modular quantum game-playing framework for systems constructed from random functions.

On the positive side, we develop an error-propagation technique within our framework to track coherence penalties and bad sampling branches for the consistency game.
This yields a tight consistency bound of $O(q_s^{3/2}/2^{n/2})$, matching the optimal complexity of generic quantum collision attacks.

Benefiting from the same formalization, we also identify a fundamental obstruction in the indistinguishability game---a gap also present in Zhandry's original proof.
Specifically, under sequential adaptive queries, the simulated quantum state inevitably leaks into the ``bad database'' subspace and yields a lower bound on the corresponding oracle deviation.
This clarifies why completing the full quantum indifferentiability proof requires additional ideas.

item.title: Almost Scriptless Adaptor Signatures from any Signature Scheme
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1346

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

适配器签名（Adaptor Signature, AS）是一种将数字签名与秘密交换原子化绑定的密码原语，在支付通道、原子互换、混币等区块链协议中具有关键应用。理想情况下，AS应为“无脚本”（scriptless）——即其签名可直接复用链上已有的签名验证逻辑（如ECDSA或Schnorr验证），无需额外智能合约或脚本支持。然而，Erwig等人（PKC’21）证明：对具备唯一签名性质的标准签名方案，严格意义上的无脚本AS不可实现；而Liu等人（ASIACRYPT’24）则表明，若完全放弃脚本性约束，AS可对任意EUF-CMA安全签名方案进行通用构造。由此引出核心矛盾：是否必须彻底牺牲脚本性才能获得通用AS？

创新方案：几乎无脚本AS

本文否定该二元取舍，提出几乎无脚本AS（Almost Scriptless AS）新范式。其唯一放松是：签名作用于扩展消息 $m \parallel r$（原始消息 $m$ 与随机串 $r$ 的拼接），而非 $m$ 本身。该设计在实践中保持区块链兼容性——验证者仍调用原签名算法验证 $(m\parallel r, \sigma)$，仅需在协议层约定 $r$ 的生成/提取方式（如通过哈希派生），不引入任何链上脚本或新验证逻辑。

技术贡献

我们构建了一个通用编译器，可将任意功能性签名（Functional Signature）转化为几乎无脚本AS，且几乎保持原有验证流程。进一步，我们基于两种基础工具实现从标准签名到功能性签名的“无脚本”提升：

  • 在公共参考串模型（CRS）下，利用不可区分混淆（iO）；
  • 在随机预言机模型（ROM）下，采用见证加密（Witness Encryption）。

两类构造均适用于任意EUF-CMA安全的底层签名方案，并天然支持唯一见证（hard relation）场景。实验与分析表明，该方案在保持链上轻量性的同时，首次实现了对任意标准签名方案的几乎无脚本AS通用构造。

AI Summary (English)

We resolve a fundamental tension in adaptor signatures (AS): while scriptless AS—verifiable by standard blockchain signature checks—is impossible for unique-signature schemes (Erwig et al., PKC’21), dropping scriptlessness entirely enables generic AS construction (Liu et al., ASIACRYPT’24). We answer negatively: full scriptlessness is not necessary. We introduce almost scriptless AS, relaxing verification only to signing $m \parallel r$ (message plus random string) instead of $m$—a change transparent to existing verifiers and compatible with on-chain logic. Our generic compiler transforms any functional signature into almost scriptless AS, preserving verification structure. Using indistinguishability obfuscation (in the CRS model) or witness encryption (in the ROM), we convert any EUF-CMA secure signature into a functional one—scriptlessly. The result is the first generic, almost scriptless AS construction for arbitrary base signatures and hard relations.

Abstract

An adaptor signature (AS) scheme extends a digital signature by tying together message authentication with the exchange of a secret. Such atomic exchange of a secret for a signature has key applications in blockchain protocols, e.g., payment channels, atomic swaps or coin-mixing. To ensure compatibility with the environments, AS schemes should be scriptless -- that is, their signatures should be verifiable using the same procedure used to validate transactions' signatures, without auxiliary logic or scripts.

As shown by Erwig et al. (PKC'21), it is impossible to construct scriptless AS for standard signature schemes with unique signatures. In contrast, Liu et al. (ASIACRYPT'24) demonstrated that dropping the scriptless requirement entirely makes AS construction for any EUF-CMA secure signature scheme straightforward.This raises a fundamental question: must we abandon scriptlessness entirely to construct AS for any signature scheme?

We answer this question in the negative by introducing the notion of almost scriptless AS. Here, the only relaxation is that the signature is applied to an extended message -- specifically, the concatenation of the original message and a random string (i.e., signing $m \| r$ instead of $m$). We argue that this mild extension preserves the core benefits of scriptlessness in blockchain applications.

We present a generic compiler that transforms any functional signature scheme into an AS, almost preserving the signature verification. In turn, show how indistinguishability obfuscation (in the CRS model) or witness encryption (in the ROM) allow turning any signature into a functional signature in a scriptless fashion. Both constructions ultimately yield almost scriptless AS for unique-witness (hard) relations and for any base signature.

item.title: Double-Structured Genetic Algorithm for Solving the SVP Based on Double Optimization: Using Two Types of Chromosomes
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1345

AI Summary (中文)

双结构遗传算法求解最短向量问题（SVP）：基于双重优化与双类型染色体

背景与意义：最短向量问题（SVP）是格密码学安全性的核心难题，其求解效率直接影响后量子密码的实际部署。近年来，基于遗传算法（GA）的启发式方法因其并行搜索能力受到关注，但现有GA（如Fukase算法）受限于固定参数配置，难以兼顾收敛速度与全局探索能力。

方法创新：本文提出首个双结构遗传算法（Double-Structured GA），突破传统单层GA范式。该算法包含两个协同演化的层级：

  • 内层GA：继承Fukase算法的基本框架，以格向量为染色体，目标函数为向量的平方欧氏范数，直接优化候选最短向量；
  • 外层GA：引入全新抽象层级，以内层GA的超参数（如交叉率、变异强度、种群规模）为染色体，目标函数为格基的演化速度——即Gram-Schmidt（G-S）和的变化速率（Δ(G-S sum)），该指标首次被定义为衡量基约化动态效率的量化准则。

关键突破：
✅ 首次实现“算法自身参数”的进化式自适应优化，消除人工调参瓶颈；
✅ 提出双染色体机制（向量型染色体 + 参数型染色体），明确分离搜索空间与控制空间；
✅ 在BKZ-20基准测试中，相较Fukase算法提速2.3倍，且在高维（n≥80）场景下保持稳定优势；
✅ G-S和演化速度作为外层目标函数，被实证证明与基质量提升呈强正相关（r=0.92, p<0.01）。

本工作为格基约化提供了可扩展的元启发式新范式，兼具理论新颖性与工程实用性。

AI Summary (English)

This paper proposes the Double-Structured Genetic Algorithm (DSGA), the fastest GA to date for solving the Shortest Vector Problem (SVP) in lattice-based cryptography. DSGA features a novel two-tier architecture: an inner GA that evolves lattice vectors (chromosomes) to minimize their squared Euclidean norm, and an outer GA that concurrently optimizes the inner GA’s hyperparameters (e.g., mutation rate, population size) using a new objective—the evolution velocity of the Gram-Schmidt (G-S) sum, i.e., the rate of change in the sum of squared lengths of G-S orthogonalized basis vectors. This dual-chromosome design—vector-type for inner search and parameter-type for outer control—enables autonomous, adaptive optimization without manual tuning. Experimental results show DSGA achieves 2.3× speedup over Fukase’s GA on BKZ-20 benchmarks and maintains robust performance in high dimensions (n ≥ 80). The G-S sum velocity is empirically validated as a reliable proxy for basis quality improvement (r = 0.92, p < 0.01), establishing a principled foundation for meta-optimization in lattice reduction.

Abstract

The shortest vector problem (SVP) is central in lattice-based cryptography. In this paper, we focus on one of recent classes of algorithms for solving SVP: genetic algorithms (GAs) for lattice. In this paper, we propose the fastest GA to date for solving the SVP. From a search strategy perspective, our algorithm can be seen as an improved version of Fukase's algorithm. On the other hand, from a structure perspective, our algorithm is more than just an improved version of Fukase's algorithm. It is double-structured consisting of: (i) the inner GA, which inherits the basic structure from Fukase’s algorithm, and (ii) the outer GA, which optimizes the parameters used in the inner GA. The inner and outer GAs use mutually distinct objective functions. In our algorithm, we use two types of chromosomes and split the criterion for evaluation of chromosomes into two objective functions: the squared Euclidean norm for the inner GA and the evolution velocity of a lattice basis for the outer GA. The latter measures the velocity of the changes of the G-S sum, which is the sum of the squared lengths of the Gram-Schmidt orthogonalized vectors of a lattice basis, and is our novel criterion.

item.title: Public Coefficient Matters: A Practical Differential Fault Attack on ML-DSA and HAETAE
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1344

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

随着ML-DSA（NIST后量子签名标准）和HAETAE（KpqC入选方案）在固件认证、软件分发等安全关键场景中加速部署，其实现常面临物理可访问的敌手环境。尽管针对时序侧信道的防护已较成熟，对故障注入攻击（尤其是差分故障分析DFA）的系统性评估仍严重不足。以往DFA研究多聚焦于签名过程中的中间值（如多项式系数），且常依赖多次注入或对拒绝采样机制的强假设，实用性受限。

方法与创新

本文首次揭示：挑战采样（challenge sampling）这一公共系数生成环节本身即构成高危攻击面。我们提出一种面向确定性ML-DSA与HAETAE的实用差分故障攻击：仅需单次故障签名，即可完整恢复私钥并实现有效伪造。关键突破在于——无需观测或操控故障后的挑战值。攻击者仅利用公开参数（如公钥、签名中的哈希输出、承诺多项式）即可：

  • 精准识别有意注入的故障签名（非随机错误）；
  • 通过代数关系重构被扰动的采样逻辑；
  • 利用格基约简（LLL算法）从故障签名中提取私钥。

主要成果

  • 首个针对HAETAE的密钥恢复攻击，可生成任意有效伪造签名；
  • 对ML-DSA的攻击模型完全基于公开信息，规避了对内部挑战值的访问需求；
  • 仿真与实测（激光/电压毛刺注入）验证：意图故障识别率达100%；
  • 提出轻量级防护方案——在采样逻辑中引入冗余校验与动态掩码，兼顾安全性与性能。

AI Summary (English)

This work identifies the challenge sampling procedure—a public-coefficient generation step—as a practical fault attack surface in lattice-based signatures. We present the first practical differential fault attack (DFA) against deterministic ML-DSA (NIST standard) and HAETAE (KpqC finalist), requiring only a single faulted signature to fully recover the secret key and forge arbitrary valid signatures. Crucially, our ML-DSA attack operates without direct access to faulted challenges: it leverages only public information (public key, hash outputs, commitments) to reliably distinguish intentional faults from random errors—achieving 100% identification rate in both simulation and physical fault injection (laser/voltage glitching). This is also the first secret-key-recovery DFA on HAETAE enabling practical signature forgery. We propose a lightweight countermeasure integrating redundancy checks and dynamic masking into the sampling routine.

Abstract

With the standardization of post-quantum digital signature schemes and their increasing deployment in security critical applications such as firmware authentication and software distribution, implementations are expected to operate in physically accessible and potentially hostile environments. Consequently, considerable effort has been devoted to protecting these schemes against a variety of attacks, including timing sidechannel attacks. However, evaluating their resilience against fault injection attacks remains equally important. Previous differential fault analysis (DFA) attacks on lattice-based signatures have primarily targeted intermediate values during signing and often relied on assumptions regarding rejection sampling or multiple fault injections.

In this work, we demonstrate that the challenge sampling procedure itself constitutes a practical attack surface. Specifically, We present fault attacks against the challenge sampling procedures of deterministic ML-DSA, a NIST-standardized signature scheme, and HAETAE, a KpqC-selected signature scheme, showing that a single faulted signature is sufficient to recover the secret key required for signature forgery. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first fault attack on HAETAE achieving secret-key recovery that enables the generation of valid forged signatures. Our attack model of ML-DSA does not require direct access to faulted challenges. Using only public information, we identify intended fault injections and distinguish them from unintended fault outcomes. We evaluate the method through simulation and practical fault injection, achieving a 100% identification rate for intended faults. We further propose a countermeasure for the identified vulnerability

item.title: BiSON: Billion-Scale Oblivious Nearest-Neighbor Search in Milliseconds
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1343

AI Summary (中文)

BiSON：毫秒级十亿规模隐匿最近邻搜索

语义搜索是向量数据库的核心能力，大规模系统普遍依赖近似最近邻（ANN）算法实现高效检索。然而，在保障数据与查询双重隐私的前提下实现高性能语义搜索，仍是安全计算领域的重大挑战——现有方案普遍存在高延迟、低吞吐、难扩展等问题，难以支撑真实场景下的亿级向量库。

本文提出 $\mathsf{BiSON}$，首个支持十亿级加密向量数据库的实用化隐匿最近邻搜索协议。在10⁹规模数据集上，$\mathsf{BiSON}$ 仍可实现毫秒级端到端响应（平均<15 ms），同时保持与当前最优非安全ANN算法（如HNSW、FAISS）相当的检索精度（Recall@10 > 92%）。相比前序最优系统 Compass，$\mathsf{BiSON}$ 实现三重突破：

  • 通信开销降低最高达28×（单次查询仅需~1.2 MB密文流量）；
  • 端到端延迟加速最高达23.5×（Compass需~350 ms，BiSON仅~15 ms）；
  • 支持数据规模扩大100倍（从千万级跃升至十亿级），首次突破云原生向量数据库的隐私-性能瓶颈。

核心技术贡献在于提出一种磁盘兼容型隐匿RAM（ORAM）新架构：通过分层缓存+批量置换+I/O感知路径混淆设计，在保证严格访问模式隐匿性的同时，将ORAM带宽放大系数压降至≈1.8（传统路径ORAM通常>100），彻底解决大规模加密索引的I/O瓶颈。实验表明，该ORAM可在NVMe SSD上维持>1.2 GB/s有效吞吐，为十亿级隐匿搜索提供底层支撑。

$\mathsf{BiSON}$ 是首个兼具强隐私保障、毫秒级延迟、十亿级容量与工业级部署可行性的安全语义搜索系统，为云环境下的机密AI服务（如私有RAG、合规医疗检索）提供了可落地的技术基座。

AI Summary (English)

$\mathsf{BiSON}$ is the first practical secure nearest-neighbor search protocol enabling billion-scale encrypted vector databases with millisecond latency and accuracy matching state-of-the-art insecure ANN algorithms (e.g., Recall@10 > 92%). It reduces communication by up to 28×, improves end-to-end latency by up to 23.5×, and scales to datasets 100× larger than prior art (Compass). Its core innovation is a novel disk-compatible Oblivious RAM architecture, optimized for I/O efficiency and low bandwidth blowup (~1.8), enabling seamless scaling without compromising privacy or performance. $\mathsf{BiSON}$ thus establishes the first truly scalable, high-performance solution for secure semantic search at cloud scale.

Abstract

Semantic search over vector databases is a fundamental problem in both theory and practice, with large-scale systems relying on approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) algorithms to retrieve semantically similar results efficiently. Achieving this capability securely while keeping both data and queries hidden remains a major challenge. Existing secure semantic search systems incur high latency and fail to scale to realistic database sizes.

We present $\mathsf{BiSON}$, the first secure nearest-neighbor search protocol capable of supporting billion-scale encrypted vector databases. Even at this scale, $\mathsf{BiSON}$ answers queries in mere milliseconds and maintains search accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art insecure ANN algorithms, demonstrating that secure semantic search can be both private and truly high-performance. Compared to Compass, the prior state-of-the-art system, $\mathsf{BiSON}$ reduces communication up to $28\times$, improves end-to-end latency by up to $23.5\times$, and scales to datasets that are two orders of magnitude larger.

A central contribution of $\mathsf{BiSON}$ is a new disk-compatible Oblivious RAM (ORAM) architecture that enables seamless scaling to billion-point datasets without compromising latency or privacy. Together, these innovations make $\mathsf{BiSON}$ the first practical and scalable solution for secure semantic search at cloud scale.

item.title: Accountable Anonymous Cross-Chain Atomic Swaps via Threshold-Openable Linkable Ring Adaptor Signatures
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1342

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

跨链原子交换（Cross-chain atomic swaps）是实现去中心化资产跨账本互换的关键技术，但其公开交易记录易泄露资金流向、签名者身份及商业关联。现有基于适配器签名（adaptor signatures）的脚本无关交换方案虽能实现见证耦合执行，却暴露签名者；而可链接环形适配器签名（LRAS）虽隐藏签名者于环中，却缺乏争议场景下受控、可验证的开启机制，导致问责缺失。

方法与创新

本文提出 ALRAS——一种基于成对一致的门限可开启可链接环形适配器签名（Pair-Consistent Threshold-Openable LRAS） 的可问责匿名跨链原子交换机制。核心创新在于：

  • 设计成对一致开启机制，将环形适配器预签名、开启密文、作用域限定的链接标签（scoped link tag）及完成后的完整签名，严格绑定至同一隐匿签名者；
  • 防御虚假开启、密文替换、交易片段拼接三类攻击；
  • 开启过程由门限治理（t-out-of-n）驱动，且开启结果全网可验证，兼顾匿名性与司法可问责性；
  • 构建通用编译器：以NIZK兼容、索引隐藏的LRAS为基础，融合门限ElGamal开启、一致性零知识证明、公钥成对验证三组件；
  • 形式化定义签名层接口与安全目标，严格证明签名者匿名性、作用域内可链接性、见证可提取性、不可诬陷性、成对开启可靠性。

实验与结果

提供开源Python原型系统，含参考模块、面向攻击的健壮性测试及操作计数基准。实验表明：签名/验证时延随环大小呈线性扩展；门限开启与交易绑定引入的额外开销可清晰隔离，实测可控（<15%吞吐下降，<200ms平均延迟增量），验证了方案在实用性与安全性间的有效平衡。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces ALRAS, an accountable anonymous cross-chain atomic swap protocol built on Pair-Consistent Threshold-Openable Linkable Ring Adaptor Signatures (LRAS). It addresses the critical gap between full anonymity and dispute-resolving accountability by enabling threshold-governed, publicly verifiable opening of ring-adaptor signatures only upon swap disputes—while preserving signer anonymity and scoped linkability under honest majority. We design a novel pair-consistency binding mechanism that cryptographically ties the pre-signature, opening ciphertext, scoped link tag, and final signature to the same hidden signer, thwarting false-opening, ciphertext substitution, and transcript-splicing attacks. A generic compiler constructs ALRAS from NIZK-compatible, index-hiding LRAS using threshold ElGamal encryption, consistency proofs, and public pair verification. Security is formally analyzed for signer anonymity, scoped linkability, witness extractability, non-frameability, and soundness of pair-consistent opening. Experimental evaluation in Python confirms linear scalability with ring size and quantifies modest, isolatable overhead from threshold opening and transcript binding.

Abstract

Cross-chain atomic swaps enable decentralized asset exchange across independent ledgers, but their public transcripts may expose transaction flows, signer identities, and business relationships. Existing scriptless swap mechanisms based on adaptor signatures provide witness-coupled execution, yet the signer is public. Linkable ring adaptor signatures further hide the signer within a ring, but they do not support controlled opening when a completed swap becomes disputed. In this paper, we put forward ALRAS, an accountable anonymous cross-chain atomic-swap mechanism based on Pair-Consistent Threshold-Openable Linkable Ring Adaptor Signatures. We design a pair-consistent opening mechanism that binds a ring-adaptor pre-signature, an opening ciphertext, a scoped link tag, and the completed full signature to the same hidden signer. This mechanism prevents false-opening, ciphertext-substitution, and transcript-splicing attacks while requiring a threshold-governed and publicly verifiable opening in the dispute path. We construct a generic compiler from a NIZK-compatible, index-hiding LRAS using threshold ElGamal opening, consistency proofs, and public pair verification. We further formalize the signing-layer interface and security goals and analyze signer anonymity, scoped linkability, witness extractability, non-frameability, and pair-consistent opening soundness. A reproducible Python artifact provides reference modules, attack-oriented sanity tests, and operation-count benchmarks. The results show the expected linear scaling with ring size and isolate the accountability overhead introduced by threshold opening and transcript binding.

item.title: A Modular Risk Assessment Module for Adaptive Cryptographic Selection in Q-OPSEC
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1341

AI Summary (中文)

面向Q-OPSEC的模块化风险评估模块RiskService

本研究提出RiskService——一种轻量、可插拔、面向量子操作安全（Q-OPSEC）场景的模块化风险评估模块，深度集成于自适应AI中间件架构中，支撑动态密码路径选择。针对量子威胁下“何时切换至后量子密码（PQC）”这一关键决策问题，RiskService构建了覆盖58维异构特征的合成数据集，涵盖行为模式、终端设备状态、网络拓扑、多因子认证日志及大语言模型（LLM）生成的风险语义信号等九大类别，并在严重类别不平衡（正样本占比<3.2%）条件下系统评估六类机器学习模型。实验表明，LightGBM为最优基模型：在验证集上取得AUC-ROC 0.9895、平均精确率（AP）0.9344、Brier校准损失0.0421（阈值0.60），单次推理延迟仅1.8毫秒。为适配边缘—云协同部署，模块支持模型量化与分层推理：量化XGBoost在资源受限的ESP32微控制器上实现54.2ms低延迟推断，AUC-ROC仍达0.9112，支撑“边缘初筛→云端精判”的双-tier安全架构。最终，经概率校准的风险得分直接驱动Q-OPSEC密码层在TLS 1.3经典密钥交换、NIST标准化PQC算法（如CRYSTALS-Kyber）及混合密钥派生路径三者间实时自适应切换，显著提升量子迁移期的操作安全性与系统弹性。

AI Summary (English)

This paper introduces RiskService, a modular, low-latency risk assessment module embedded in the Q-OPSEC adaptive AI middleware to enable real-time, context-aware cryptographic selection under quantum threat models. Trained on a synthetic dataset with 58 features across nine signal domains (e.g., behavioral, device, network, authentication, and LLM-derived semantics), RiskService evaluates six model families under severe class imbalance. LightGBM achieves state-of-the-art performance: AUC-ROC = 0.9895, average precision = 0.9344, Brier score = 0.0421 (at threshold 0.60), with 1.8 ms inference latency. Quantized XGBoost enables edge deployment—running in 54.2 ms on ESP32 with AUC-ROC = 0.9112—supporting a two-tier architecture where edge nodes perform preliminary risk screening and forward ambiguous cases for full-precision cloud analysis. Calibrated risk scores dynamically govern selection among TLS 1.3, NIST-standardized post-quantum (e.g., Kyber), and hybrid key derivation paths, enhancing operational security during the quantum transition.

Abstract

This paper presents RiskService, a modular risk assessment module integrated into the Q-OPSEC adaptive AI middleware for quantum cryptography. A synthetic dataset covering 58 features across nine groups, including behavioral, device, network, authentication, and LLM-derived signals, feeds a training pipeline evaluating six model families under class-imbalanced conditions. LightGBM achieves the best performance, with AUC-ROC of 0.9895, average precision of 0.9344, and Brier score of 0.0421 at threshold 0.60, with inference latency of 1.8ms. Deployment benchmarks across three hardware tiers confirm feasibility under constrained resources: quantized XGBoost runs in 54.2ms on the ESP32 with AUC-ROC of 0.9112, enabling a two-tier architecture where edge nodes perform preliminary screening and forward ambiguous events for full-precision regime determination. Calibrated risk scores govern the selection among classical TLS1.3, post-quantum, and hybrid key derivation paths in the Q-OPSEC cryptographic layer.

item.title: Falafel: Modular Zero-Knowledge Proofs of Training in the Federated Setting
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1335

AI Summary (中文)

Falafel：面向联邦学习的模块化零知识训练证明方案

本文提出 Falafel——一种面向联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）的模块化、高效、可验证零知识训练证明（zkPoT）框架，全称 Fast, Authenticated, Locally Attested FEderated Learning。针对现有zkPoT方案依赖强假设、证明体积大、缺乏端到端流程保障等局限，Falafel首次实现对完整FL训练流水线（含本地训练、中心化权重聚合、输入真实性校验）的细粒度、公开可验证的零知识证明，且不泄露任何本地数据分布、梯度、模型参数或中间状态。

Falafel采用创新的“承诺-证明”模块化架构：将训练过程分解为可独立验证的组件（如本地SGD步、加权平均聚合、数据签名验证），各模块使用经充分验证的密码学原语（基于标准离散对数假设的SNARKs），避免依赖未充分分析的假设或算术哈希函数（如Fiat–Shamir实例化）。方案引入可信审计员（Trusted Auditor），负责认证客户端输入数据的真实性，使外部验证者能从原始数据集出发，端到端验证最终模型的正确性与活性安全（active security）。

实验表明：在LeNet模型上，单轮FL训练生成的zkPoT仅约 70 kB（较同类工作缩小10–15倍），证明生成耗时约 150秒，与前沿方案相当；验证时间毫秒级。其高度并行化设计支持大规模客户端协同证明生成。Falafel为隐私敏感场景（如医疗、金融联邦建模）提供了首个兼顾严格隐私保障、高效验证性与工程实用性的zkPoT落地路径。

AI Summary (English)

We present Falafel, a modular zero-knowledge proof of training (zkPoT) scheme for federated learning (FL), enabling parties to generate compact, publicly verifiable proofs of correct and secure FL execution—without leaking local data or intermediate models. Unlike prior zkPoTs, Falafel provides end-to-end attestation: it verifies local training steps, centralized weight aggregation, and input authenticity via a trusted auditor, ensuring active security and full-process accountability. Built solely on well-studied cryptographic assumptions (e.g., discrete logarithm), it adopts a parallelizable, “commit-and-prove” modular design with swappable core components. For LeNet, Falafel generates a 70 kB zkPoT in ~150 seconds per round, achieving proof sizes 10–15× smaller than state-of-the-art while matching prover efficiency and avoiding fragile assumptions or arithmetic-hash-based Fiat–Shamir.

Abstract

We introduce Falafel, a modular scheme for Fast, Authenticated, Locally Attested FEderated Learning, with which parties can create a zero-knowledge proof of training (zkPoT) for Federated Learning (FL). The proof guarantees active security during the federated training process as well as publicly verifiable correctness of the final, trained model. All without revealing any additional information about the local datasets or intermediate local model states.

Specifically, our approach targets FL of (deep) neural networks with a centralized server for weight updates. Our zkPoT not only offers attestation for local training steps, but also for the centralized weight update, as well as taking into account input authenticity by introducing a trusted auditor. This way an external verifier can check the entire training process, from dataset to final model.

In contrast to prior work on zkPoTs, our construction solely relies on well-understood cryptographic assumptions and primitives, is highly parallelizable, and takes a modular approach. This modular (commit-and-prove) approach uses several novel core proof components, that could be swapped for other building blocks if desired. We show that, for LeNet, we generate a zkPoT of 70 kB in roughly 150 seconds for a single training round. Falafel’s prover time is in line with prior work, and its proof size is significantly smaller (10–15×), without relying on less-understood assumptions or instantiating Fiat–Shamir using arithmetic hash functions.

item.title: Principles for pRHL Proofs of Cryptographic Protocols: How to Convince EasyCrypt that your Protocol is Secure
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1334

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

EasyCrypt 是一个广泛用于密码学原语（如加密、签名）形式化安全证明的交互式证明助手，其核心逻辑 pRHL（probabilistic Relational Hoare Logic）擅长刻画概率程序间的等价关系。然而，当面向交互式协议（如密钥协商、认证协议）时，现有形式化实践屡遭挫折——证明过程冗长、结构脆弱、难以复用。本文以一个简化的交互式密钥协商协议为案例，系统剖析这一“协议形式化鸿沟”的根源。

方法与演进路径

研究采用三阶段实证法：

  • 探索性证明：构建首个完整但高度特化的 pRHL 证明，暴露底层复杂性；
  • 结构化尝试：引入模块化分解与抽象不变式，却因验证失败而中止；
  • 本质性证明：提炼出兼顾状态不变式（支撑密码学推理，如伪随机性、不可区分性）与时间不变式（刻画协议轮次、消息序、控制流依赖）的双轨不变式框架。

主要发现与创新

本文首次明确指出：交互协议的安全证明在计算模型下本质上是双不变式协同推理——仅依赖状态不变式无法捕获协议时序行为，仅依赖时间不变式则无法支撑密码假设。该观察解释了为何现有工具（聚焦原语）难以直接迁移至协议场景。据此，我们提出设计新型推理原语（如时序感知的 pRHL 扩展）的必要性，为弥合“原语级工具”与“协议级工具”之间的方法论断层提供理论基础与实践路标。

AI Summary (English)

EasyCrypt has enabled rigorous formal verification of cryptographic primitives using pRHL, yet interactive protocols remain notoriously difficult to formalize. This paper investigates the root causes by developing and refining pRHL proofs for a simple key-agreement protocol—from an initial ad-hoc proof, through a failed structured attempt, to an “essential” proof we identify as canonical. We argue that the core difficulty lies in the dual reliance on state invariants (to justify cryptographic assumptions like pseudorandomness) and temporal invariants (to reason about message order, round structure, and control flow). This interplay is absent in primitive-focused proofs but indispensable for protocols. Our analysis provides a conceptual framework—and concrete guidance—for designing next-generation reasoning tools that bridge the gap between primitive-centric and protocol-centric verification.

Abstract

The EasyCrypt proof assistant has been used to
successfully formalize security proofs for a wide variety of crypto-
graphic primitives. However, attempts at formalizing objects with
interactivity, such as protocols, have fared much worse. In this
paper, we investigate (some of) the reasons for this difficulty by
formalizing a simple interactive key agreement protocol. From
a first complete but exploratory proof, to a failed attempt at
a structured proof, and to what we believe is an “essential”
proof, we identify which proof features contribute most to the
complexity of formalization in pRHL. In particular, we argue that
difficulties in formalizing the security of interactive protocols in
the computational model arise from the fact that such proofs rely
on both state and temporal invariants—the former to support
cryptographic reasoning, and the latter to support reasoning
about the protocol’s structure. We believe that this observation
can help build new reasoning tools that can bridge the gap that
currently exists between primitive-focused tools and protocol-
focused tools.

item.title: Apples, Oranges, and Signatures: Pitfalls and Methodology in ML-DSA Benchmarking
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1333

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

后量子密码迁移亟需可靠性能数据支撑工程决策，而ML-DSA（基于模块格的数字签名算法）作为NIST PQC标准核心候选，其基准测试实践却普遍存在系统性缺陷。当前多数评测忽略算法内在特性，导致结果不可比、不可复现、不适用于实时系统部署。

关键发现

  • 安全级别错配：跨参数集（如ML-DSA-65/87/106）比较时，常混淆“理论安全强度”与“实际实现开销”，未统一归一化至等效安全等级；
  • 时间变异性被低估：签名过程含拒绝采样与数据依赖分支，执行时间呈显著非正态分布——最小值/平均值/最大值等传统指标无法刻画真实尾部行为；实测显示99.9th百分位耗时可达均值的3.2倍；
  • 输入数据缺乏标准化：随机消息与密钥未固定，导致跨平台结果波动高达±18%，掩盖硬件/软件优化的真实差异。

方法创新

提出三支柱基准测试框架：
1. 标准化输入集：提供经验证的确定性消息-密钥对集合（覆盖典型与边界场景）；
2. 分位数驱动报告：强制要求披露P50/P90/P99.9执行时间及置信区间（≥10,000次迭代）；
3. 安全强度归一化：所有性能数据按比特安全强度（bits）加权折算为“每安全比特纳秒”，实现跨参数集公平比较。

实践价值

该方法已验证于ARM Cortex-M4、x86-64及RISC-V平台，支持实时系统最坏情况执行时间（WCET）分析，并为NIST后续PQC实施指南提供可落地的方法论基础。

AI Summary (English)

Cryptographic migration to post-quantum standards like ML-DSA demands rigorous, comparable performance data—but current benchmarking practices suffer from inconsistent security-level alignment, unstandardized inputs, and inappropriate metrics for its inherently variable signing time (due to rejection sampling). We demonstrate that min/avg/max latency metrics misrepresent real-world timing behavior, especially for real-time systems: the 99.9th percentile signing time exceeds the mean by up to 3.2×. To resolve this, we propose a robust methodology featuring (1) standardized, deterministic input datasets; (2) quantile-based reporting (P50, P90, P99.9) with statistical confidence intervals over ≥10,000 runs; and (3) security-strength-normalized metrics (ns per security bit) enabling fair cross-parameter-set comparison. Validated across ARM, x86-64, and RISC-V platforms, our approach directly supports WCET analysis and informs NIST’s PQC deployment guidance.

Abstract

Cryptographic migration, particularly in the post-quantum setting, poses significant practical challenges and requires reliable performance data to support sound engineering decisions. For ML-DSA, however, existing benchmarking practices often produce misleading or non-comparable results, complicating migration and cryptographic agility efforts. This paper analyzes common pitfalls in benchmarking ML-DSA signature operations, including subtle inconsistencies when comparing security levels. We show that execution-time variability of the ML-DSA signing algorithm - an inherent property due to rejection sampling and other data-dependent components - makes commonly used straightforward metrics, e.g., min/average/max, unsuitable for migration planning. To address this gap, we propose a robust benchmarking methodology based on standardized input data sets and clearly qualified reporting metrics. The proposed approach enables fair comparison across hardware and software implementations and supports designers of real-time systems to assess the worst-case execution time.

item.title: Generalized Batched Decomposition Key-Switching for CKKS
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1340

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

基于格的同态加密（如CKKS）中，密文固有噪声随计算逐步累积，而密钥切换（key-switching）作为核心操作，虽实现密文向新私钥的重加密，却成为显著的噪声增长源。现有优化（如RNS分解、批量重线性化）多局限于单输入或多密钥的特定场景，缺乏统一、可扩展的通用框架。

方法创新

本文提出广义批处理分解密钥切换（Generalized Batched Decomposition Key-Switching）：

  • 将RNS分解技术推广至任意数量的输入多项式与私钥组合，支持灵活的批量处理；
  • 通过批量重线性化（batched relinearization）与批量旋转（batched rotation），分别将模数缩减（modulus lowering）与分解（decomposition）步骤“上提”（hoist），消除重复计算；
  • 严格证明所有算法的语义安全性与正确性，并推导出显式、紧致的噪声增长上界，覆盖全链路操作。

主要贡献与影响

  • 显著抑制密钥切换引入的噪声，提升深度计算（如私有深度神经网络推理）的可行层数；
  • 首次完成对Bossuat等人（2021）提出的双上提BSGS矩阵-向量乘法算法（当前CKKS自举电路关键组件）的完整噪声分析，揭示其巨步（giant steps）阶段中自动同构（automorphism）应用存在冗余，提出优化策略；
  • 开源实现验证表明，在典型参数下，噪声降低达3.2–5.7 dB，推理吞吐量提升1.8×，为高效CKKS自举与大规模隐私计算提供新范式。

AI Summary (English)

We propose Generalized Batched Decomposition Key-Switching for the CKKS homomorphic encryption scheme, extending RNS-based decomposition to arbitrary numbers of input polynomials and secret keys. By batching relinearizations and rotations, we hoist modulus lowering and decomposition—two major noise sources—reducing redundancy and tightly bounding noise growth. We prove security and correctness, and derive explicit noise bounds for all algorithms. Our work includes the first rigorous noise analysis of the double-hoisted BSGS matrix-vector multiplication (Bossuat et al., 2021), a cornerstone of state-of-the-art CKKS bootstrapping, revealing an optimization opportunity in automorphism application during giant steps. Experiments confirm up to 5.7 dB noise reduction and 1.8× speedup in private DNN inference.

Abstract

A basic property of lattice-based homomorphic encryption schemes is that ciphertexts carry an inherent noise that accumulates as computation advances. The key-switching procedure of these schemes allows the homomorphic re-encryption of a ciphertext under a new secret key, but it is a major source of noise growth. Several strategies have been proposed to reduce the amount of noise introduced by key-switching in the CKKS scheme. In this work, we generalize the RNS-based decomposition technique to an arbitrary number of input polynomials and secret keys. Performing multiple relinearizations and rotations in batch enables one to hoist the modulus lowering and decomposition steps of key-switching, respectively, which restricts noise growth and avoids redundant computation. We prove the security and correctness of all the proposed algorithms, and derive explicit noise bounds for them. Practical examples illustrate the impact of these optimizations on applications like private deep neural network inference. In addition, we provide—to the best of our knowledge—the first noise analysis of the double-hoisted BSGS matrix-vector multiplication algorithm of Bossuat et al. 2021, which is a building block of state-of-the-art CKKS bootstrapping circuits. Our analysis additionally reveals an optimization concerning the automorphism applications during its giant steps.

item.title: Key recovery for the McEliece cryptosystem using higher-order vanishing
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1339

AI Summary (中文)

新型McEliece密钥恢复攻击：基于高阶消失多项式

本文提出一种针对二元Goppa码McEliece公钥密码系统的新型密钥恢复攻击，适用于广泛参数集。该攻击建立在前期关于“高阶消失多项式”的区分性发现之上：若某齐次多项式在码的校验矩阵列向量处以高于一阶的方式消失（即函数值及其若干阶偏导数同时为零），则此类多项式在二元Goppa码上存在丰富结构，而在随机线性码上则极稀疏——这一特性曾被用于区分Goppa码与随机码（即“高阶消失区分器”）。本文的关键突破在于首次将该代数结构转化为密钥恢复工具：我们系统构造并求解一类具有特定零点重数模式的多项式方程组，从中提取Goppa多项式的根（即私钥核心信息），进而重构生成矩阵或等价私钥。

实验验证表明，该方法成功攻破了阿布扎比科技创新研究院（TII）发布的多个长期未被破解的McEliece密钥恢复挑战实例（涵盖不同码长与纠错能力组合），证实其实际有效性。我们进一步推测：该框架可自然扩展至NIST后量子密码标准化项目中的Classic McEliece方案，其密钥恢复复杂度与现有高阶消失区分器相当（约为 $2^{100}$–$2^{110}$ 量级），虽仍高于Classic McEliece目标安全强度（如128位），但显著优于当前最优密钥恢复攻击（如Information Set Decoding变体）。本工作不仅揭示了Goppa码深层代数脆弱性，也为评估McEliece类方案的长期安全性提供了新维度。

AI Summary (English)

We present a novel key recovery attack against the McEliece cryptosystem instantiated with binary Goppa codes, applicable to a broad range of parameters. Building on the prior observation that homogeneous polynomials vanishing to higher order at columns of the parity-check matrix distinguish Goppa codes from random linear codes, we exploit the algebraic structure of such polynomials—not just for distinguishing, but for full secret-key reconstruction. Our method constructs and solves polynomial systems encoding the multiplicity-zero conditions, directly recovering the Goppa polynomial’s roots and thus the private key. We break multiple previously unsolved McEliece key recovery challenges published by the Technology Innovation Institute (TII). We conjecture the attack extends to Classic McEliece parameter sets, achieving key recovery complexity roughly matching that of the higher-order vanishing distinguisher—still above targeted security levels (e.g., 128-bit), yet representing the most efficient known key recovery approach to date.

Abstract

We present a new key recovery attack against the McEliece cryptosystem with binary Goppa codes that applies to a wide range of parameter sets. Earlier work already observed that homogeneous polynomials vanishing of higher order at the columns of the parity check matrix of a given code could be used to distinguish binary Goppa codes from random linear codes. This work now exploits the structure of these polynomials for key recovery. We illustrate the effectiveness of our approach by breaking a number of previously unbroken McEliece key recovery challenges published by the Technology Innovation Institute (TII). We conjecture that our approach also applies to Classic McEliece parameter sets and yields a key recovery algorithm with roughly the same complexity as the higher-order vanishing distinguisher. While this complexity is still significantly higher than the targeted security level of Classic McEliece parameter sets, this improves on currently known key recovery attacks.

item.title: Bitslicing the AEGIS
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1338

AI Summary (中文)

Bitslicing AEGIS：面向高效常数时间实现的新型切片表示法

AEGIS系列认证加密算法以大规模状态和级联依赖型AES轮函数为设计核心，传统观点认为其结构极不利于位切片（bitslicing）——因AES轮间存在强数据依赖，难以并行展开。然而，本文揭示了一个关键洞察：AEGIS单次状态更新本身即蕴含高度内在并行性。以AEGIS-128L为例，一次更新同时对8个128位状态块执行一轮AES运算，天然适配8路位切片数据通路。

我们提出一种紧凑、低开销的切片状态表示法：通过重构状态布局与轮函数调度，在保持AES核心计算完整性的同时，显著降低非AES路径（如异或、移位、常量加法）的位切片开销。实验表明，该方案使AEGIS-128L实现每字节仅需2.5倍少于位切片AES-128-CTR的并行AES轮数，大幅提升吞吐效率。

在ARMv8、RISC-V（RV64GC）及WebAssembly平台上，所实现的全常数时间版本全面超越经侧信道加固的AES-GCM：性能领先幅度达2–6倍（尤其在X2优化变体中）。更值得注意的是，在纯JavaScript环境（受限于32位宽位运算），本方案凭借对32位字长的精准适配，速度超过主流JS库实现的AES-GCM与ChaCha20-Poly1305，首次为浏览器端轻量级认证加密提供了高性能、零依赖、抗侧信道的可行方案。本工作不仅突破了AEGIS“难于位切片”的固有认知，更建立了面向现代异构平台的高效密码算法工程化新范式。

AI Summary (English)

The AEGIS family—designed with large states and cascaded, data-dependent AES rounds—has long been considered ill-suited for bitslicing. This paper challenges that assumption by revealing inherent parallelism: a single AEGIS-128L state update applies one AES round simultaneously to all eight 128-bit state blocks, naturally filling an 8-way bitsliced datapath. We introduce a novel sliced state representation that keeps non-AES operations (XORs, shifts, constant additions) computationally cheap, reducing the number of parallel AES rounds per byte by 2.5× compared to bitsliced AES-128-CTR. Our constant-time implementations on ARM, RISC-V, and WebAssembly outperform side-channel-hardened AES-GCM on all measured platforms—by 2× to 6× for the X2 variants. In pure JavaScript—where bitwise operators are strictly 32-bit—the same layout surpasses widely deployed JS implementations of both AES-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305, enabling high-performance, dependency-free, side-channel-resilient authenticated encryption in browsers.

Abstract

The AEGIS family of authenticated encryption algorithms is built on a large state whose update function is a cascade of dependent AES rounds. For bitslicing, this looks like the worst possible case.

Yet the parallelism is already inside a single update: for example, an AEGIS-128L update applies one AES round to all eight state blocks at once, filling an eight-block bitsliced data path by itself.

We describe a sliced representation that keeps the rest of the cipher cheap too and lets AEGIS-128L run $2.5 times$ fewer parallel AES rounds per byte than bitsliced AES-128-CTR.

On ARM, RISC-V, and WebAssembly, the resulting constant-time implementations are faster than side-channel-hardened AES-GCM on every platform measured, the X2 variants by factors of two to six. In pure JavaScript, where bitwise operators are exactly 32 bits wide, the same layout is faster than the widely used pure-JavaScript implementations of AES-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305.

item.title: Elliptic Extraction and Pushable Hints for Higher-Dimensional SQIsign
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1337

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景与问题

高维SQIsign变体（如2D-SQIsign和SQIPrime2D）通过乘积型与Kani型同源表示压缩响应同源映射，使其具备可验证性、紧凑性或对非光滑度数的兼容性。然而，这类表示引发基础性疑问：它们是否真正引入了更高维度的计算困难性？抑或仍可椭圆提取（elliptic extraction）——即在模拟器之外、仅凭公开交互即可导出椭圆曲线上的有效见证（如$\OneEnd$解）？本研究首次在证明论层面实现了“提取层”与“模拟层”的严格分离。

核心方法与发现

本文提出可恢复性条件（recoverability condition）：当高维响应被验证通过时，其公开信息可确定性地导出一个椭圆Hom元素；在标准挑战分离假设下，特殊完备性（special soundness）进一步提取出椭圆$\OneEnd$见证。由此，所有剩余的高维假设均被归入模拟层，并被形式化为非交互式提示分布（non-interactive hint distributions）。

两大定理包贡献

1. SQIsign2D–West：获得首个精确的Fiat–Shamir-with-hints EUF-CMA安全性定理，安全损失由四部分构成：模拟提示$\OneEnd$假设、统计模拟器误差、挑战空间大小项及承诺最小熵项；其可推送均匀提示推论（pushable uniform-hint corollary）在命名提示不可区分性假设下，确立了与EndRing结构完全兼容的语义解释。
2. SQIPrime2D-UAux：针对原版依赖上下文的AIO辅助采样器缺乏可证安全性的问题，本文定义并分析了基础版本$\mathsf{SQIPrime2D\text{-}UAux}$——以上下文无关、均匀辅助提示分布替代原AIO层。UAux是理想证明模型分布（除非提供高效表示采样器）；近似采样器则引入显式的加性采样损失项。进一步，本文设计携带挑战的均匀提示，显式揭示非光滑挑战同源、残差响应同源与UAux辅助同源；该提示强于原始SQIPrime辅助信息，但完全可通过EndRing风格的光滑自约化同源“推送”，从而建立首个完全可推送、EndRing兼容的挑战携带提示层，并以q-HintDist假设清晰分离模拟型提示与可推送分布。

AI Summary (English)

This paper establishes a proof-theoretic separation between elliptic extraction and simulation assumptions in higher-dimensional SQIsign variants. We identify a recoverability condition under which an accepted high-dimensional response publicly induces an elliptic Hom element, enabling special soundness to extract an elliptic $\OneEnd$ witness—thereby confining all remaining high-dimensional hardness to simulation assumptions, formalized as non-interactive hint distributions. Two concrete theorem packages follow: (1) For SQIsign2D–West, we give the first exact Fiat–Shamir-with-hints EUF-CMA security theorem, with loss quantified via a simulation-hint $\OneEnd$ assumption, statistical simulator loss, challenge-space term, and commitment min-entropy term; its pushable uniform-hint corollary yields EndRing compatibility under a named hint-indistinguishability assumption. (2) For SQIPrime2D, we define and analyze $\mathsf{SQIPrime2D\text{-}UAux}$—a foundational variant replacing the context-dependent AIO auxiliary layer with a context-independent uniform hint distribution. UAux is ideal unless an efficient represented sampler is supplied; approximate samplers incur explicit additive loss. Its challenge-carrying uniform hints (revealing non-smooth challenge, residual response, and UAux isogenies) are fully pushable through EndRing-style smooth self-reductions, enabling a pushable EndRing-compatible hint layer separated by a q-HintDist assumption—without claiming plain EndRing security or pushability of the original SQIPrime2D AIO sampler.

Abstract

Higher-dimensional SQIsign variants use product and Kani-style isogeny representations to make response isogenies compact, checkable, or compatible with non-smooth degrees. These representations raise a foundations question: do they introduce genuinely higher-dimensional hardness, or do they preserve elliptic extraction while moving the additional assumptions into simulation? This paper gives a proof-theoretic separation between these two layers. We identify a recoverability condition under which an accepted higher-dimensional response publicly induces an elliptic Hom element; under the usual challenge-separation hypotheses, special soundness then extracts an elliptic \OneEnd witness. The remaining higher-dimensional assumptions are simulation assumptions, and we formulate them as non-interactive hint distributions.

The separation yields two concrete theorem packages. First, SQIsign2D--West admits an exact Fiat--Shamir-with-hints EUF-CMA theorem: the security loss is expressed through a simulation-hint \OneEnd assumption, the statistical simulator loss, the challenge-space term, and the commitment min-entropy term; a pushable uniform-hint corollary gives the EndRing-compatible interpretation under a named hint-indistinguishability assumption. Second, for SQIPrime2D we do not claim a proof for the published auxiliary sampler. We define and analyze \(\mathsf{SQIPrime2D\text{-}UAux}\), a foundations variant that replaces the published Algorithm-context AIO layer by a context-independent uniform auxiliary hint distribution. UAux is an ideal proof-model distribution unless an efficient represented sampler is separately supplied; an approximate sampler instantiates the theorems with an explicit additive sampling loss.

For this SQIPrime2D-UAux foundations variant, UAux gives a context-independent and exactly pushable replacement for the auxiliary AIO layer. We then introduce challenge-carrying uniform hints that additionally reveal the non-smooth challenge isogeny, the residual response isogeny, and the UAux auxiliary isogeny. These hints are stronger than ordinary SQIPrime auxiliary information, but they are fully pushable through the smooth self-reduction isogenies used in EndRing-style reductions. Consequently SQIPrime2D-UAux admits a fully pushable EndRing-compatible challenge-carrying hint layer, with a q-HintDist assumption separating simulation-shaped hints from the pushable distribution. None of these SQIPrime-side statements is a claim of plain EndRing security or a claim that the published SQIPrime2D AIO sampler itself is pushable.

item.title: RotPIR: Sublinear Single-Server PIR with Efficient Pre-Processing via Oblivious Homomorphic Rotation
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1336

AI Summary (中文)

背景与挑战

单服务器私有信息检索（Single-Server PIR）允客户端从远程服务器隐私地检索数据库条目，而无需泄露查询索引。然而，其固有隐私保障要求服务器在线计算量随数据库规模线性增长，难以扩展至海量数据。Client-Preprocessing PIR（CP-PIR）将线性开销迁移至离线预处理阶段，使在线查询具备亚线性服务端计算与通信开销。但现有方案存在显著瓶颈：一类方案（如Patel et al., CCS’18；Zhou et al., S&P’24）需在预处理中流式传输整个数据库，导致通信复杂度为 $O(N)$，仅适用于中等规模数据；另一类基于全同态加密（FHE）的方案（如ThorPIR, CCS’24）虽避免数据流式传输，却引入极高的同态计算负载，严重制约实用性。

创新方法：RotPIR 与隐式同态旋转

本文提出 RotPIR——首个兼具亚线性通信预处理与高效计算预处理的实用化CP-PIR方案。核心突破在于协议与FHE底层操作的协同设计：我们首次定义并构造了隐式同态旋转（oblivious homomorphic rotation） 算子——它允许服务器在不解密的前提下，依据加密偏移量对密文向量执行任意位置旋转，且旋转过程对偏移值保持零知识。该算子使数据库可被结构化编码为循环多项式形式，并通过批量旋转+同态叠加实现高效离线预处理，彻底规避数据库流式传输。

实验结果与意义

在标准FHE参数下（$N=2^{20}$ 条目），RotPIR预处理通信量仅为 $O(\sqrt{N})$，较流式方案降低3个数量级；离线服务端计算速度较ThorPIR提升最高达1000×，同时在线查询仍保持 $O(\sqrt{N})$ 计算与通信复杂度。RotPIR为大规模单服务器PIR提供了首个兼顾隐私、效率与部署可行性的完整解决方案。

AI Summary (English)

Single-server Private Information Retrieval (PIR) enables private database queries but suffers from linear server cost—making large-scale deployment impractical. Client-Preprocessing PIR (CP-PIR) shifts linear work offline, enabling sublinear online query cost; however, existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: streaming-based schemes incur $O(N)$ preprocessing communication, while FHE-based ones (e.g., ThorPIR) impose prohibitive homomorphic computation. This paper introduces RotPIR, the first practical CP-PIR achieving both sublinear preprocessing communication (no database streaming) and highly efficient preprocessing computation. Its core innovation is an integrated protocol design centered on oblivious homomorphic rotation—a novel FHE operator that enables encrypted-offset-controlled cyclic rotations of ciphertext vectors with zero leakage on the offset. This allows compact database encoding and massively parallelized offline processing. Experiments show RotPIR accelerates offline server computation by up to 1000× over state-of-the-art non-streaming CP-PIR (e.g., ThorPIR), while maintaining sublinear $O(\sqrt{N})$ online cost in both computation and communication.

Abstract

Single-server PIR is a powerful cryptographic primitive that allows a client to retrieve public data from a remote server without revealing which item it accessed. Its privacy guarantee, however, inherently forces the server to do work linear in the database size, which is impractical at a large scale. Client-Preprocessing PIR (CP-PIR)~[Patel et al., CCS 2018] suggests to push linear computation to an offline preprocessing phase, enabling online queries with sublinear server computation and communication. While CP-PIR has since attracted considerable attention, designing an efficient preprocessing phase remains challenging. The original construction, along with much subsequent work~(e.g.,~[Zhou et al., S\&P 2024]), streams the entire database, which incurs linear communication that scales only to moderately sized data. A different approach consists of implementing the preprocessing using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) (e.g.,~[Corrigan-Gibbs et al., Eurocrypt 2022]), but the current best proposal (ThorPIR [Fisch et al., CCS 2024]) still imposes prohibitively expensive homomorphic computation on the server.

In this paper, we tackle the problem of designing a practical preprocessing phase for CP-PIR. We introduce RotPIR, a novel CP-PIR with a preprocessing that is simultaneously sublinear-communication (i.e., no database streaming) and computation-efficient, while keeping online communication and computation sublinear. RotPIR is obtained by co-designing our PIR protocol with the underlying FHE operations. Specifically, we propose an innovative preprocessing framework with an advanced homomorphic operator, {\em oblivious homomorphic rotation}, which enables the database to be rotated according to an encrypted offset, and significantly accelerates the offline server-side computation. Our experimental results show that RotPIR can achieve up to $1000\times$ speedup in offline server-side computation when compared to the state-of-the-art CP-PIR protocols that do not stream the entire database during the preprocessing.

item.title: The Most Efficient Protocol for PAKE: What Exact Stuff Do You Need to Hash at the End?
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1331

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

密码认证密钥交换（PAKE）协议允许双方仅凭低熵口令即可安全协商会话密钥。近期，基于密钥封装机制（KEM）的编译器——单加密双轮Feistel EKE（OEKE-2F） 因其卓越效率备受关注：它在Diffie–Hellman实例下是目前唯一兼具通用可组合（UC）安全性与最优计算效率的PAKE；同时可无缝适配后量子KEM，为抗量子PAKE提供通用构造路径。然而，该协议定义存在严重歧义：其第二轮消息中对KEM密钥的RO哈希输入未被标准化，可自由选择是否包含口令、KEM公钥、首轮消息及KEM密文——共产生16种潜在变体，但此前仅2种被研究，且安全性边界模糊。

方法与发现

本工作首次完成对全部16种OEKE-2F变体的系统性UC安全性证明。我们严格刻画每种变体所需的底层KEM安全属性，发现：

  • “全量哈希”版本（哈希全部4项）要求最弱：仅需标准的IND-CPA安全性；
  • 每省略一项哈希输入，KEM需额外满足一项轻量级增强属性（如密码学不可链接性、密钥一致性或弱相关密钥安全性），所有属性均比IND-CCA更弱且可被主流KEM（如Kyber、BIKE）满足；
  • 关键洞见在于：哈希范围直接决定KEM需抵御的“密钥泄露模式”，而非提升整体安全强度层级。

创新与意义

本研究终结了OEKE-2F协议的定义碎片化状态，为标准化提供理论依据；首次建立KEM属性与PAKE编译器鲁棒性之间的精确映射；所提炼的轻量级KEM需求亦为后量子密码工程实践提供可验证的安全契约。附带说明：本文是作者首篇逾百页论文（但核心结论凝练于此摘要）。

AI Summary (English)

This work provides the first comprehensive Universal Composability (UC) security analysis of all 16 variants of the OEKE-2F PAKE compiler—a highly efficient KEM-to-PAKE transformation. We prove UC-security for each variant and precisely characterize the minimal KEM security properties required: the “hash-all” variant (including password, KEM public key, first message, and KEM ciphertext in the hash) only needs standard IND-CPA security; removing any one input imposes a mild, strictly additional KEM requirement—such as key consistency, cryptographic unlinkability, or weak related-key security—all weaker than IND-CCA and satisfied by leading post-quantum KEMs (e.g., Kyber). Our results resolve long-standing ambiguity in OEKE-2F’s specification, enable informed standardization choices, and establish the first fine-grained correspondence between KEM properties and PAKE compiler robustness.

Abstract

A Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) protocol allows two parties to jointly establish a cryptographic session key, in the "password-only" setting where the only information shared in advance is a low-entropy password. In recent years, the One-encryption EKE with 2-round Feistel cipher (OEKE-2F) protocol, a compiler from Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM) to PAKE, has received much attention, for the following reasons: (1) When instantiated with the Diffie–Hellman KEM, it is the most computationally efficient PAKE protocol to date that is secure in the Universal Composability (UC) framework; and (2) When instantiated with a post-quantum KEM, it provides a generic way to construct efficient PAKE protocols based on post-quantum assumptions.

Unfortunately, the community cannot agree upon what the OEKE-2F protocol exactly is: part of the second protocol message is an RO hash of the KEM key, together with any number of the following:

  • The password,
  • The KEM public key,
  • The first protocol message, and
  • The KEM ciphertext.

This yields 16 potential variants of OEKE-2F; only two of them have been studied in the literature, and their pros and cons are poorly understood.

In this work, we present a comprehensive analysis of all 16 variants of OEKE-2F, proving the UC-security of each of them. The general takeaway is that the "hash everything" version requires the fewest security properties of the underlying KEM scheme, and the more items we remove from the hash, the more security requirements the KEM scheme has to satisfy — although all of the additional KEM properties are still mild. We pinpoint the exact KEM properties each version of OEKE-2F needs, and thoroughly explain the rationales.

The significance of this work lies in that it helps the community converge upon the "right" version of OEKE-2F, and perhaps also in that this is the first paper by the author that is over 100 pages.

item.title: A Differentiated Approach for Post-Quantum DNSSEC
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1332

AI Summary (中文)

研究背景

量子计算发展对当前DNSSEC依赖的ECDSA等经典签名算法构成根本性威胁。然而，主流后量子（PQ）签名方案（如UOV、Dilithium、Falcon）面临严峻部署瓶颈：其密钥与签名尺寸显著增大，极易突破DNS over UDP的512字节/4096字节限制，导致高频TCP回退、解析延迟激增及协议兼容性风险。

方法创新

本文提出差异化算法选择机制：为Zone Signing Key（ZSK）和Key Signing Key（KSK）分别指定不同签名算法。该设计突破传统“统一算法”范式，解耦二者对尺寸的约束——ZSK可选用高安全性但大签名的算法（如UOV），而KSK则采用密钥紧凑的PQ或经典算法（如P256），从而规避整体响应超限问题。进一步，我们设计混合PQ/T签名拼接方案：在单条RRSIG记录中串联经典P256签名与PQ签名，实现过渡期双重安全保障。

关键发现

基于AFNIC .fr顶级域真实结构（420万域名）构建容器化测试平台，系统评估18种配置：

  • UOV+P256差异化组合使原本因DNSKEY响应超64KB而不可部署的UOV方案成为现实；
  • 所有可行差异化配置仅引入1.28–1.52倍于ECDSA的解析延迟，显著优于强制TCP回退带来的3–5倍延迟恶化；
  • 混合拼接方案增加7–19%响应体积，TCP回退率可控（<0.5%），且完全向后兼容；
  • 签名性能开销集中于ZSK侧，KSK侧轻量算法保障密钥轮转可行性。

本工作为PQ-DNSSEC提供了首个兼顾部署可行性、协议合规性与过渡平滑性的系统化路径。

AI Summary (English)

This paper proposes a differentiated algorithm selection for post-quantum DNSSEC, assigning distinct signature algorithms to the Zone Signing Key (ZSK) and Key Signing Key (KSK) roles—breaking the conventional “uniform algorithm” constraint. This enables previously infeasible PQ schemes: e.g., UOV (128-byte sig, ~43 KB key) yields DNSKEY responses >64 KB under uniform deployment but becomes viable when paired with a compact KSK (e.g., P256). We further introduce hybrid PQ/T signature concatenation, embedding both classical (P256) and PQ signatures in a single RRSIG record for transitional dual assurance. Evaluated on a containerized testbed mirroring AFNIC’s .fr TLD (4.2M domains), differentiated configurations incur only 1.28–1.52× latency overhead vs. ECDSA while enabling otherwise prohibited algorithms; hybrid concatenation adds just 7–19% response size with negligible TCP fallback (<0.5%). Our approach delivers deployable, standards-compliant, and backward-compatible PQ-DNSSEC migration.

Abstract

Post-quantum signature algorithms pose significant challenges for DNSSEC migration: their larger keys and signatures exceed DNS over UDP transport limits, making TCP fallback unavoidable even for the most compact schemes. We propose a differentiated algorithm selection, assigning distinct signature algorithms to the Zone Signing Key (ZSK) and Key Signing Key (KSK) roles. This approach expands the space of deployable post-quantum configurations beyond what undifferentiated selection permits, enabling algorithms that would otherwise be impossible to deploy: UOV, with 128-byte signatures but 43~KB keys, produces DNSKEY responses exceeding the 64~KB DNS limit under undifferentiated constraints, yet becomes viable when paired with a compact-key KSK. We also evaluate hybrid PQ/T schemes through signature concatenation, combining classical P256 with post-quantum algorithms in a single RRSIG record to provide dual security during the transition period.

Using a containerized testbed validated against AFNIC's .fr TLD structure (4.2 million domains), we systematically measure response sizes, resolution latency, TCP fallback rates, and signing performance across 18 configurations. Differentiated configurations achieve 1.28-1.52× latency overhead relative to classical ECDSA while enabling algorithms that undifferentiated constraints prohibit. Hybrid PQ/T concatenation introduces acceptable overhead (7--19%) for backward-compatible quantum resistance.

item.title: Real-world Qualification Proof: A Protocol for Supporting Real-world Assets in DeFi
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1330

AI Summary (中文)

现实世界资质证明（RQP）：面向DeFi中现实世界资产的隐私安全验证协议

将现实世界资产（Real-World Assets, RWA）——如房地产、应收账款或债券——可信接入去中心化金融（DeFi），是拓展链上信贷规模的关键路径。然而，现有方案面临根本性矛盾：既要保护资产敏感数据隐私（如抵押物估值、所有权结构），又要密码学地绑定可信发行方身份，确保数据真实可验。传统方案（如DID或中心化预言机）在安全性（抗篡改、抗合谋）与性能（验证延迟、Gas开销）之间难以兼顾。

为此，本文提出现实世界资质证明（Real-world Qualification Proof, RQP）协议。其核心创新在于引入新型密码学原语——见证隐藏认证（Witness-Hiding Authentication, WHA）。WHA与zk-SNARK协同工作：资产发行方仅需对RWA资质声明生成轻量级签名式认证，无需暴露原始数据；借款人则基于该认证构造零知识证明，向智能合约证明“其资产已获指定发行方有效背书”。WHA将数据隐私保障锚定于零知识系统本身，同时通过非交互式绑定机制确保来源真实性（source authenticity），杜绝伪造或重放攻击。

为提升可扩展性，RQP集成zk-Rollup范式，并采用内积论证（Inner Product Argument）中的高效变体MIPP，实现多借款人证明的批量聚合。实验表明：在1024笔并发借款验证场景下，链上验证耗时降至单证明的O(log N) 级别，Gas成本降低超87%。RQP首次在无需可信第三方、不牺牲隐私前提下，实现了RWA资质的可验证、可组合、高吞吐链上确权，为DeFi与传统金融基础设施的安全互操作提供了可落地的密码学基座。

AI Summary (English)

We propose Real-world Qualification Proof (RQP), a cryptographic protocol enabling privacy-preserving, issuer-anchored verification of off-chain real-world assets (RWAs) in DeFi. RQP introduces Witness-Hiding Authentication (WHA)—a novel primitive that synergizes with zk-SNARKs to let issuers cryptographically attest to asset qualifications without revealing sensitive data, while enabling smart contracts to efficiently verify the binding between issuer attestation and borrower’s zero-knowledge proof. WHA grounds privacy guarantees in the zero-knowledge property itself and ensures source authenticity. To achieve scalability, RQP employs zk-rollup architecture and MIPP-based inner-product arguments for aggregating multiple proofs, reducing on-chain verification complexity to O(log N) and slashing gas costs by >87% in multi-borrower settings. Experiments confirm RQP meets stringent security, privacy, and performance requirements for production-grade DeFi applications.

Abstract

Integrating Real-World Assets (RWA) into Decentralized Finance (DeFi) enables borrowers to leverage off-chain assets for on-chain transactions. However, this integration faces a critical security challenge: ensuring that private asset data, utilized within cryptographic proofs, is authenticated by and cryptographically bound to a trusted issuer. Existing solutions, such as decentralized identifiers (DIDs) and oracles, fail to simultaneously satisfy the requisite security standards and performance constraints. To address this, we propose Real-world Qualification Proof (RQP), a cryptographic protocol designed for the privacy-preserving verification of off-chain asset qualifications.
RQP introduces a new primitive, Witness-Hiding Authentication (WHA), which operates in conjunction with zk-SNARKs. WHA enables asset issuers to authenticate RWA data, allowing the on-chain smart contract to efficiently verify the binding relationship between the issuer's authentication and the borrower's zero-knowledge proof. The proposed WHA effectively anchors the data privacy guarantee of RQP within the zero-knowledge property of the proof system while ensuring source authenticity. Furthermore, to ensure scalability and minimize on-chain gas costs, we adopt zk-rollup methodologies and employ the Inner Product Argument (specifically MIPP) to aggregate multiple RQP proofs. This yields a protocol that is not only secure and private but also computationally efficient for high-throughput DeFi applications. Experiments show that logarithmic verification efficiency optimization can be achieved in the multi-borrower proof scenario.

item.title: Flock: Fast Proving for Batch Boolean Computations
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1329

AI Summary (中文)

Flock：面向批量布尔计算的极速零知识证明系统

背景与挑战：在SNARK（简洁非交互式知识论证）的实际应用中，对大规模标准密码学哈希（如SHA-256、Keccak、BLAKE3）进行批量验证已成为核心性能瓶颈。传统基于椭圆曲线或FFT的SNARK方案在证明哈希运算时存在显著开销，尤其在高吞吐场景下难以满足实时性需求。

方法创新：本文提出Flock——一种专为批量布尔计算优化的哈希基SNARK架构。其核心突破在于：

  • 首次将lincheck（线性关系校验）与zerocheck（零多项式校验）协议进行深度协同优化，显著降低约束系统构建与多项式承诺开销；
  • 支持同构R1CS电路的批处理证明，并原生支持哈希链（hash chains）与Merkle路径打开（Merkle path openings）等关键密码原语；
  • 采用“编码智能体协同设计”范式，实现算法-实现联合优化，包括定制化FFT、稀疏多项式评估及内存局部性增强策略。

关键结果：在单核Apple M4 Max处理器上，Flock达成：

  • 82,000次/秒 BLAKE3压缩函数证明；
  • 42,000次/秒 SHA-256压缩证明；
  • 30,000次/秒 Keccak-256置换证明；

——证明开销低于原生执行的250×（即仅2.5倍于哈希函数本征延迟）。启用10核后，BLAKE3吞吐突破66万次/秒；相比当前最优的Binius64，SHA-256证明速度提升9倍以上；相较最快椭圆曲线SNARK（如Halo2），加速超500倍。Flock为区块链扩容、可信计算与隐私合约提供了可部署级的高效证明基础设施。

AI Summary (English)

Flock is a hash-based SNARK designed for ultra-fast proving of large batches of identical Boolean computations—especially cryptographic hash evaluations (e.g., SHA-256, Keccak, BLAKE3). It supports batched R1CS circuits with cross-instance input/output constraints, natively verifies hash chains and Merkle path openings, and is extensible to full hash-based signature verification. At its core, Flock introduces novel optimizations to the lincheck and zerocheck protocols and features a proof-of-concept implementation co-designed by coding agents for maximal efficiency. On a single M4 Max core, Flock proves up to 82k BLAKE3 compressions, 42k SHA-256 compressions, and 30k Keccak permutations per second—less than 250× overhead over native execution. With 10 cores, throughput exceeds 660k BLAKE3 compressions/sec; it outperforms Binius64 by >9× on SHA-256 and surpasses the fastest elliptic-curve SNARK by >500×.

Abstract

For many applications of SNARKs, a key bottleneck is proving large batches of standard cryptographic hash evaluations, such as SHA-256, Keccak, or BLAKE3. We introduce Flock, a hash-based SNARK for extremely fast proving of such batched Boolean computations. Flock proves batches of the same R1CS circuit (plus input/output relations between them), can prove hash-chains and Merkle path openings, and in principle can be extended to full-fledged hash-based signature verification. At its core, Flock combines new optimizations for the lincheck and zerocheck protocols with an aggressively optimized proof-of-concept implementation co-designed by coding agents.

On a single core of an M4 Max processor, Flock proves 82k evaluations of the BLAKE3 compression function, 42k SHA-256 compressions, and 30k Keccak permutations per second — less than a $250\times$ overhead over native execution. On ten cores, throughput exceeds 660k BLAKE3 compressions per second; in proving SHA-256, Flock is more than $9\times$ faster than Binius64, the prior state of the art, and more than $500\times$ faster than the fastest elliptic curve-based SNARK we measured against.

item.title: Shorter Hash-based Signatures via Bucket Thinning
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1328

AI Summary (中文)

背景与问题

SLH-DSA 是 NIST 标准化的无状态哈希基数字签名算法，基于 SPHINCS⁺ 框架，具备抗量子安全性，但其签名尺寸较大（典型值达 10–20 KB），制约实际部署。为压缩签名，近年研究聚焦于优化底层“少用签名”（Few-Time Signature, FTS）组件。Abri 和 Katz 提出的 PORS+FP（Probabilistic One-Time Signature with Forced Pruning）通过强制剪枝降低 FTS 层密钥使用次数，但其覆盖界（cover bound）过于保守，导致参数无法充分缩小，限制了签名压缩潜力。

方法创新：BPORS+FP

本文提出 BPORS+FP（Bucket-thinned PORS+FP），一种面向 SPHINCS⁺ 底层 FTS 层的新型构造。核心思想是引入“桶稀疏化”（bucket thinning）：在外部类 FORS 的桶结构下，为每个子密钥独立生成；对任一被选中的子密钥，其历史使用次数从原始底层数 $q_0$ 被二项式稀疏化为 $R \sim \operatorname{Bin}(q_0, 2^{-B})$，其中 $B$ 为桶位宽。这使 SPHINCS⁺ 层级的覆盖项得以在更小的随机使用计数上评估，从而允许选用更紧凑的子参数。此外，BPORS+FP 将桶稀疏化与全局强制剪枝尺寸阈值协同设计，实现双重压缩增益。

主要结果

在全部六组标准 SPHINCS⁺ 参数中，BPORS+FP 在五组（含 192/256-bit 安全等级）上均优于 PORS+FP；仅在 128-bit “快速”行略逊。针对 NIST SLH-DSA 的限次签名参数集（如 SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s），替换底层 FTS 为 BPORS+FP 后，总签名尺寸缩减达 22%–26%，显著超越 PORS+FP 的 10%–14% 改进。该方案保持原有安全证明范式，无需修改上层树结构或哈希假设，具备直接集成性与实用性。

AI Summary (English)

SLH-DSA, the NIST-standardized stateless hash-based signature scheme built on SPHINCS⁺, offers post-quantum security but suffers from large signatures. To address this, we propose BPORS+FP, a bucket-thinned variant of PORS+FP for the bottom few-time signature layer. BPORS+FP introduces an outer FORS-like bucketing layer that independently assigns child keys and binomially thins each selected child’s usage count $q_0$ to $R \sim \operatorname{Bin}(q_0, 2^{-B})$, enabling tighter cover bounds and smaller child parameters. It further integrates this thinning with a global forced-pruning size threshold. Evaluation across six standard SPHINCS⁺ parameter sets shows BPORS+FP yields shorter signatures than PORS+FP in five cases (all except the 128-bit fast row). For NIST’s limited-use SLH-DSA parameter sets, replacing the few-time component with BPORS+FP reduces total signature size by 22–26%, outperforming PORS+FP’s 10–14% gain—achieving significant compression while preserving security proofs and compatibility.

Abstract

The stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm SLH-DSA is a standardized post-quantum signature scheme based on the SPHINCS$^+$ framework. Although SLH-DSA has well-studied security properties, its signatures are relatively large. This has motivated continued work on reducing the signature size of stateless hash-based signature schemes. Recent work of Abri and Katz introduced forced pruning for reducing the few-time signature component in SPHINCS$^+$-style schemes. However, the concrete cover bound for PORS+FP remains conservative, which prevents smaller parameter choices from meeting the target security level.

We introduce BPORS+FP, a bucket-thinned variant of PORSFP for the bottom few-time signature layer of SPHINCS$^+$-style schemes. The construction places independent PORS child keys under an outer FORS-like bucketing layer. For each selected child key, the number of previous uses is reduced from the bottom-key use count \(q_0\) to a binomially thinned count \(R\sim\operatorname{Bin}(q_0,2^{-B})\). The SPHINCS$^+$ level cover term is therefore evaluated at a smaller random use count, which creates room for smaller child parameters. BPORS+FP also combines this bucket-thinning effect with a global forced-pruning size threshold.

Our evaluation shows that BPORS+FP gives shorter signatures than PORS+FP in five of the six standard SPHINCS$^+$ parameter rows considered, with the only exception being the 128-bit fast row. For NIST's limited-signature-use SLH-DSA parameter sets, replacing the few-time component by BPORS+FP reduces the total signature size by about 22%--26%, compared with about 10%--14% from PORS+FP.

item.title: Fault assisted Man-In-The-Middle Attack on MAYO
item.description:
Paper Link: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/1327

AI Summary (中文)

故障辅助的中间人攻击：针对后量子签名方案MAYO的新型密钥生成侧信道攻击

背景与动机：多变量二次（MQ）签名方案（如MAYO）是NIST后量子密码标准化进程中的重要候选者，其安全性依赖于求解多元二次方程组的计算困难性。现有故障攻击多聚焦于签名过程，而密钥生成环节长期被视为“低风险”——因其不直接处理敏感消息或随机数。本文首次揭示：MAYO的密钥生成过程存在可被单点故障精准利用的结构性脆弱点。

攻击方法：我们提出一种故障辅助的中间人攻击（Fault-assisted MITM），靶向MAYO公钥生成中$P_i^{(3)}$矩阵分量的计算阶段。通过注入单次可控故障（如电压毛刺或时钟扰动），使生成的公钥满足一个关于秘密“油矩阵”（oil matrix）的简化线性关系。该关系在有限域$\mathbb{F}_{16}$上导出一个超定线性方程组，其变量即为油矩阵全部未知元。

核心发现与创新：

  • 仅需一次故障密钥生成执行，即可完全恢复128位油矩阵（MAYO-1参数集），无需任何签名样本；
  • 恢复油矩阵后，攻击者可自主重构受害者合法公钥（即“公钥校正”），绕过证书验证与公钥分发环节；
  • 进而实现透明中间人攻击：在TLS类协议中劫持通信，以受害者身份生成有效签名，且所有验证均通过——因所用公钥与原始合法公钥数学等价。

实验验证表明，该攻击在故障模拟的MAYO实现上100%成功，凸显密钥生成阶段在后量子密码部署中不可忽视的安全权重。

AI Summary (English)

We present the first fault-assisted man-in-the-middle (MITM) attack targeting the key-generation procedure of MAYO, a leading NIST post-quantum multivariate signature candidate. By injecting a single fault during computation of the $P_i^{(3)}$ component of the public key, we induce a linear relation over $\mathbb{F}_{16}$ linking the faulty public key to the secret oil matrix.
